summary.en: You do not need the full encyclopedia. Pick one song, find its year, then add one neighboring act.
summary.zh: 不必通读百科。先定一首歌、查年份，再加一支相邻乐队。

body.en:
Rock history looks like a warehouse of albums. In practice it works more like reply chains: each scene answers the last one.

Blues first. Rock & roll puts it on radio. Britain sends it back louder in the mid-60s. The 70s split into stadium hard rock, prog complexity, and three-chord punk. The 80s harden metal and post-punk. The 90s put grunge and Britpop on the same decade with different agendas. Indie keeps claiming small-room values while playing large festivals.

Do not memorize that paragraph. Use it as a map. Timeline is chronological browsing. Genre Map is for when someone says "post-punk" and you want the family tree. People pages track the same musician under different logos.

Rule for newcomers: do not start from "I should know everything." Start from one song you already care about. Open that era. Add one related band. Stop when you want. The archive will still be there.
body.zh:
摇滚史看起来像专辑仓库。实际更像回复链：每个场景都在回答上一个。

先是 Blues。Rock & roll 上电台。60 年代中期英国把它更大声寄回来。70 年代拆成体育馆硬摇滚、前卫复杂结构，和三和弦朋克。80 年代金属与后朋克定型。90 年代 grunge 与 Britpop 同年代、不同议程。Indie 一边自称小场美学，一边站在大型音乐节上。

这段不用背，当地图用。Timeline 按年代刷。Genre Map 是有人说「后朋」时查谱系用的。People 页追踪同一人换 logo 的路径。

新人规矩：别从「我应该全懂」开始。从一首你已经在意的歌入手。打开那个年代。加一支相关乐队。想停就停。档案还在。
